verdict.rationale: Jev exposes a documented public HTTP API. It has a `POST /v1/systemone` endpoint and a `GET /v1/models` endpoint with cURL examples and a response schema, plus official Python and JavaScript SDKs, documented rate limits, retry behavior and versioned model IDs. Community users confirm hands-on API access and real-time use. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed spec paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Every model on this page is served by the same endpoint, `POST /v1/systemone`. The request's `model` field selects which one handles the call
`GET /v1/models` returns the names your account can send in the `model` field, with a description and release date for each
Our client SDKs provide typed questions and answers for the TypeSafe API and handle retries automatically with their default retry policy.
Use AsyncTypeSafeClient to ask questions, list models, and configure asynchronous TypeSafe API requests.
